description: This Java class implements the StaffWritePlatformService interface using JPA repositories. It provides methods for creating and updating staff records in the database, handling data integrity issues, and managing transactions. The class uses Lombok annotations for boilerplate code reduction and includes detailed exception handling for database constraint violations.

classes.name: StaffWritePlatformServiceJpaRepositoryImpl
classes.description: Implementation of staff writing service using JPA repositories, containing methods for creating and updating staff entities with transaction management and data integrity handling.

methods.name: createStaff
methods.description: Creates a new staff record after validating input JSON, resolving office reference, and saving the entity. Handles database integrity exceptions.

methods.name: updateStaff
methods.description: Updates an existing staff record with new data from JSON command, including office reassignment, with exception handling for data integrity.

methods.name: handleStaffDataIntegrityIssues
methods.description: Private helper method that interprets database exception messages to throw meaningful application exceptions for duplicate externalId or displayName.
